## User value

Describe what the plugin lets a Mewmori user do.

## Privacy and safety

- [ ] I declared every permission and network host used by the plugin.
- [ ] The plugin contains no credentials, private data, downloaded executable code, or hidden telemetry.
- [ ] Remote content is treated as untrusted data.
- [ ] Sending, publishing, paying, deleting, and form submission require explicit user action and confirmation.
- [ ] Secret settings are never logged, emitted as activities, or written to plugin storage.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] I installed the plugin from its local directory in a direct Mewmori build.
- [ ] I tested invalid settings, offline behavior, and clean shutdown.
- [ ] The README documents setup, retained data, deletion, permissions, and network hosts.

## Evidence

Add concise test output or privacy-safe screenshots when useful.
